refutes.claim: No changed line touches `SuppressSourceGeneration`. The hunks only stop the type collector from throwing on duplicate or mixed keys: they skip the member after MsgPack005/MsgPack006 and use first-wins insertion. So the likely regression path is not addressed: a `[MessagePackObject(SuppressSourceGeneration = true)]` type with no duplicate or mixed keys is assumed to be skipped before member analysis since 3.1.1. Its missing-key member would then still get no MsgPack004 (and no MsgPack003/005). The acceptance criterion says MsgPack0xx diagnostics must be reported for such types as in 3.1.0. Ledger L14 exempts only the generation-only rules 011/016/017, not MsgPack004.
